correctness.rationale: The checkerboard probability matrix has strictly positive entries and exact row/column sums \(1/3\), so the induced piecewise-constant density is an absolutely continuous copula with uniform margins. Exact cellwise integration gives \(\int C^2=1/9\), hence \(J=1/36=J_0\). Nonindependence follows from unequal cell probabilities and is independently witnessed by \(ho_S=64/363\).
